preconditions: Use implemented distribution schemas; no project, network, schema plugin or user file is a schema provider.
steps: List the resources; retrieve their full field schemas; validate real positive and negative field fixtures and execute project-free commands.

oracle.requirement_contract: `specroad schema show <SCHEMA-ID> --format json` MUSS das vollständige Schema einschließlich Beschreibungen, Defaults, Beispielen, Enumwerten und deprecation-Hinweisen ausgeben.
oracle.scope: Complete available structural schema catalog and actual project-free CLI/API retrieval. Field schemas are not lifecycle, graph or evidence approval.

open_items: Future mapping/exchange schemas join only with their real implementations. Full Python/platform matrix and release approval remain open. Cross-field, profile, graph and publication checks are additional to exported field schemas.
